review_model.description: Model used specifically for review sessions

model_context_window.description: Context window tokens available to the active model.

project_doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to include from an AGENTS.md project doc file.

project_doc_fallback_filenames.description: Additional filenames to try when looking for project-level docs.

hide_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoning` events will be hidden from the UI/output

show_raw_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoningRawContentEvent` events will be shown in the UI/output.

approval_policy.description: Controls when Codex pauses for approval before executing commands.

sandbox_mode.description: Sandbox policy for filesystem and network access during command execution.

network_access.description: Allow outbound network access inside the workspace-write sandbox.

exclude_tmpdir_env_var.description: Exclude `$TMPDIR` from writable roots in workspace-write mode.

exclude_slash_tmp.description: Exclude `/tmp` from writable roots in workspace-write mode.

notify.description: Command invoked for notifications; receives a JSON payload from Codex.

instructions.description: Reserved for future use; prefer `experimental_instructions_file` or `AGENTS.md`.

model_reasoning_effort.description: Adjust reasoning effort for supported models (Responses API only).

model_reasoning_summary.description: Select reasoning summary detail or disable summaries entirely.

model_verbosity.description: Control GPT-5 Responses API verbosity (defaults to `medium`).

model_supports_reasoning_summaries.description: Force Codex to send reasoning metadata even for unknown models.

model_reasoning_summary_format.description: Override the format of reasoning summaries (experimental).

file_opener.description: URI scheme used to open citations from Codex output (default: `vscode`).

chatgpt_base_url.description: Override the base URL used during the ChatGPT login flow.

forced_login_method.description: Restrict Codex to a specific authentication method.

forced_chatgpt_workspace_id.description: Limit ChatGPT logins to a specific workspace identifier.

command.description: Launcher command for an MCP stdio server.

args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP stdio server command.

env.description: Environment variables forwarded to the MCP stdio server.
